offer.text: They're pressing the gate again tonight. Plant your feet by the wall with me and cut down eight of them — give ground and the whole street is theirs.

accept.text: Then hold this ground. Not one step back.

decline.text: Then stand aside for those who'll fight.

in_progress.text: Hold the line! How many at the gate have you dropped?

ready.text: Eight down and the gate still ours. Well held.

complete.text: You stood your ground when it counted. The watch won't forget it.
